hero.title: Dinner at *The Willcox*
hero.lede: An award-winning American kitchen and a curated wine program, served in the hotel’s dining room, the club-like lobby or out by the pool. Breakfast, lunch, afternoon tea, dinner and late bites, every day.

sections.title: An American kitchen *with a well-traveled chef*

image.alt: Friends dining under equestrian paintings in the plaid-curtained dining room

body: The kitchen’s reputation is built on the creative talents of its chefs. The menu is American, though the executive chef draws inspiration from international travels, and the wine program is recognized for its selection from renowned regions around the world.
Enjoy Southern breezes poolside, the cozy club setting of the lobby, or the dining room. Wherever you sit, the cooking is seasonal and, whenever possible, sourced from sustainable and local farms.
list: Seasonal and locally sourced when possible

sections.title: Take The Willcox *to the polo*

image.alt: Two guests in folding chairs watching polo from a rug-and-table picnic set on the field

body: Willcox Provisions make entertaining easy: place your order, pick it up and enjoy. Each chef-prepared offering comes with everything you need, from plates to napkins, so a picnic at the polo field or a concert on the lawn feels like a table at the restaurant.
Takeaway works the same way for every day. The breakfast, lunch, dinner and bites menus are all available for pick-up: call (803) 648-1898 to order.
list: Everything packed, down to the napkins
Breakfast, lunch, dinner and bites to go
